svg.desc: Dammam HVDC Substations LOCATION KSA CLIENT Areva -T&D And Ministry of Water & Elect. (KSA) COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2008 76 million Euros DISCIPLINES Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2008 in Dammam, KSA, this substation project for the Ministry of Water and Electricity in collaboration with Areva (T&D) involved the construction of a back-to-back converters facility for high voltage direct current (HVDC). Valued at 76 million Euros, the project played a key role in strengthening the region's power transmission infrastructure.
